scope: frozen gradual_v1 onset/wake residual calibration only; no physiological-constant or recommendation-benefit inference

train_hyperparameters.groups: separate cohort, arm, and onset/wake channel
train_hyperparameters.mu: equal mean of participant clipped-residual means
train_hyperparameters.R: equal mean of within-participant sample variances among participants with n>=2; if none exist use the 1 min^2 floor and flag the fallback
train_hyperparameters.T: max(sample variance of participant means - R*mean(1/n), 1)
train_hyperparameters.affine_x: (frozen prediction - participant-balanced Train centre) / max(participant-balanced Train SD, 60 minutes)
train_hyperparameters.affine_loss: sum over participants of participant mean squared error plus 1*L2 squared coefficient penalty toward zero
train_hyperparameters.individual_affine_prior: Train global affine mean with diagonal covariance diag(T,T); engineering prior, not a slope variance-component estimate

candidate_formulas.eb_static_intercept: Gaussian posterior N(mu,T) with unweighted eligible personal residual likelihood variance R
candidate_formulas.eb_h14_intercept: Gaussian posterior with 14-day exponential weights treated as fractional likelihood
candidate_formulas.kalman_random_walk_q01: scalar state prior N(mu,T), process variance 0.01*R*elapsed calendar days, observation variance R
candidate_formulas.kalman_ou_h14: mean-reverting scalar state F=2^(-elapsed_days/14), process variance T*(1-F^2), observation variance R
candidate_formulas.individual_bayes_affine_h14: Train affine coefficient prior updated with eligible personal z=[1,x] residuals using 14-day fractional likelihood

selection.metric: equal mean of participant-macro joint MAE across cmi/mesa and data/hybrid
selection.validation_gate: aggregate gain >= 1 minute and no worsening in any of four cohort-arm cells

locked_test_gate.bootstrap_unit: participant with shared sampled indices across data and hybrid within cohort
locked_test_gate.multiplicity: Bonferroni familywise 95% across four cohort-arm cells
locked_test_gate.pass: validation gate passes, Test aggregate gain >= 1 minute, and every cell CI lower bound > 0

interpretation_limits: Gaussian updates after residual clipping and fractional recency weights are approximate empirical-Bayes calculations, not calibrated posterior probabilities.
Frozen-model Train residuals may be optimistic because the models were developed from related Train data.
Short and sparse within-person histories limit individual slope identification, especially in MESA.
These methods estimate residual calibration only and cannot identify individual tau_w, tau_s, circadian phase, light sensitivity, or recommendation benefit.
In the normalized CMI/MESA input observed_at equals wake; this is an offline availability assumption, not validation of real reporting, upload, or synchronization delay.
MESA includes PSG staging, but these inputs do not contain the repeated EEG/SWA, PVT, or DLMO observations needed to fit individual physiological time constants.
Validation and Test have been reused in prior analyses and are not fresh external or prospective confirmation.
